parsed.summary: Targeting $2 billion annual revenue by March 2027
parsed.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
parsed.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

parsed.summary: Aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31
parsed.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
parsed.quote: Over the course of this intensive offsite, we not only charted our priorities and focus areas for FY27 but also assessed our progress towards our long-term aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31 and did intensive trainings on the AI side for our entire leadership.

parsed.summary: Effective Tax Rate for FY26 expected between 20% and 24%
parsed.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
parsed.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
